questions.question: The famous 11-day long ‘Dhanu Jatra’, considered as the largest open-air theatre of the world is celebrated in which state?
questions.solution:
**The famous 11-day long ‘Dhanu Jatra’,** considered as the largest open-air theatre in the world is celebrated in **__Odisha.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Spread over an 8 km radius area around the municipality of Bargarh, it is the** largest open-air theatre in the world, **one that is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
 
• It is based on Krishna's mythological tale (locally known as Krushna), and his demon-uncle Kansa.
 
• It is about the episode of the visit to Mathura by Krishna and Balaram to witness the ceremony of Dhanu, arranged by their (maternal) uncle Kansa.
 
• In November 2014, the** Government of India's Department of Culture awarded Dhanu Yatra the status of the National Festival.**

questions.question: ​In which year was the Nahargarh Fort built in Jaipur by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II?
questions.solution:
​In __**1734**__, the **Nahargarh Fort** was built in Jaipur by **Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II.**

 
• He was the ruler of the **Amber kingdom.**
 
• He founded the Jaipur city and made it capital.
 
• In 1699, the Mughal Emperor, **Aurangzeb**, who had summoned him to Delhi impressed by his intellect, gave him the title of Sawaii.
 
• The **Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah** awarded him the title of **Saramad-i-Rajaha-i-Hind** on 21 April 1721.

questions.question: ​As per the government rules, how much percentage of advance tax needs to be paid by 15th June by an individual who is liable to pay advance tax?
questions.solution:
​As per the government rules, __**15%**__ of advance tax needs to be paid by 15th June by an individual who is liable to **pay advance tax.**

 
• Advance tax means **earnings tax will be charged **in advance, rather than** lump-sum payment at year-end.**
 
• The way you collect tax is also known as **earn tax. **
 
• Such payments are to be made in installments as given by the income tax department according to the due dates.
 
• When your gross tax liability in a** financial year is Rs 10,000 or more** you will pay the advance tax.

questions.question: ​In which year was the Currency Building in the BBD Bagh or Dalhousie area of Kolkata constructed?
questions.solution:

questions.question: Which dynasty built the pancha rathas of Mahabalipuram?
questions.solution:
__**Pallava dynasty**__ built the **Pancha rathas of Mahabalipuram.**

 
• This was an Indian dynasty, which ruled a portion of **southern India from 275 CE to 897 CE. **Since the extinction of the Satavahana dynasty which the Pallavas served as feudatories, they gained prominence.
 
• During the reign of** Mahendravarman I (571–630 CE), and Narasimhavarman I (630–668 CE) **it became a major power.
 
• Pallavas built the** Shore Temple in Mamallapuram, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.**
 
• They **developed the script for Pallava** from which Grantha eventually descended.

questions.question: What is the colour of the light emitted by the Sun?
questions.solution:
__**The white colour**__ of the **light emitted by the Sun.**

 
• The actual **Sun colour is white. **
 
• The reason the Sun appears bright to us is that the Earth's atmosphere disperses higher wavelength colours less quickly, such as red, orange and violet. These wavelengths are, indeed, what we see, due to this the **Sun appears yellow.**
 
• The white colour is the composite of **all visible light frequencies**.
 
• The **highest wavelength of light is Red and the lowest wavelength of light is violet.**

questions.question: In terms of area, which state has the largest forest cover in India?
questions.solution:
In terms of **area**, __**Madhya Pradesh**__ has the **largest forest cover in India.**

__
 
• It is the second-largest state by area after Rajasthan in India, and the **fifth-largest state by population.**
 
• The capital of Madhya Pradesh is **Bhopal.**
 
• The largest city of Madhya Pradesh is **Indore.**
 
• As per the economy, it is the **10th largest state economy in India.**

**Notes:**

 
• Area-wise **Madhya Pradesh**__ has the largest forest cover in the country followed by **Arunachal Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha,** and **Maharashtra**.
 
• In terms of forest cover as a** percentage** of total geographical area, the top five States are **Mizoram (85.41%)**,** Arunachal Pradesh (79.63%)**, **Meghalaya (76.33%)**, **Manipur (75.46%)** and **Nagaland (75.31%)**.
